test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a code language, 'SPACE' is written as '5-91' and 'ROTTEN' is written as '6-70'. How will 'MEAN' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e82b7da6e41b2a069e2db44b7b686c69a4d8afae6d389dc05a659aaeaa56953.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Number of letters = 1st number**

**Sum of the opposite position value of the given alphabet = 2ⁿd Number**

'SPACE' is written as '5-91' 

SPACE = 5 letters

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c25e24eb26cdc1b08e610de3917d21c9ee82fe26e9e0027fdd4b8f762939b46.png] 

8 + 11 + 26 + 24+ 22 = 91 

And

'ROTTEN' is written as '6-70'

ROTTEN = 6 letters

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49cef54092cfa3dff897262021ad958841e7c9b3320ea0b97600110d2bd04f51.png] 

9 + 12 + 7 + 7 + 22 + 13 = 70

Similarly,

MEAN is written as 4-75

MEAN = 4 letters

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6e57159275b1b4eeb33967dce75429bf00ba99cb08d307e6b5deb408602bd4f.png] 

14 + 22 + 26 + 13 = 75 

Hence, **"Option 1" **is the correct answer.
